findings.title: Unrestricted partner fee recipient and partner fee allocation in partner fee-sharing swap flows
findings.description: The vulnerability exists in the `collect_fee_sol_to_b()` and `collect_fee_spl_to_b()` functions, which support partner fee-sharing by splitting fees between the protocol and a designated partner based on an externally supplied `partner_fee_rate`. The root cause is the lack of on-chain validation for the partner account and the absence of an upper bound restriction on `partner_fee_rate`, which can be set to FEE_RATE_BASE, allowing the partner to receive the entire fee amount. An attacker could exploit this by supplying a malicious partner account and setting the fee rate to 100%, redirecting all fees to their control. The impact is that protocol fee revenue can be unintentionally or maliciously redirected to untrusted external accounts during partner-integrated swaps, potentially leading to complete loss of fee income for the protocol.
